# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

Change the user-visible label "Data Science Projects" to "Projects" everywhere it appears in the Dashboard UI (navigation entries and page headings), and update the corresponding documentation captions and references that mention the old label. This is a pure string/label change: no behavior, routing, or API changes are involved, and no Kubernetes resources or CRDs are renamed.

Usability testing showed the current label confuses users arriving from OpenShift, where the same resources are already called projects. Product management has approved the shortening.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in Dashboard navigation entries.
- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in Dashboard page headings.
- Update localization/string entries carrying the old label (limited to the changed label; no broader localization review).
- Update documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label in the affected topics (touch-ups only; no new content authored).

Out of scope (per strategy):

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs.
- Localization string review beyond the changed label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard navigation, when a user views it, then the entry formerly labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled "Projects".
- Given Dashboard pages that previously carried the "Data Science Projects" heading, when a user opens them, then the heading reads "Projects".
- Given the Dashboard UI surfaces (navigation and page headings), when searched, then no occurrence of the "Data Science Projects" label remains.
- Given the affected documentation topics, when a user reads them, then captions and references to the old label are updated to "Projects".
- No behavioral, routing, or API changes are introduced — the change is limited to user-visible strings and the corresponding documentation touch-ups.
- Rollback safety: reverting the change restores the previous label with no data or configuration migration.

## HLR Traceability

| HLR | Priority | Coverage |
|-----|----------|----------|
| HLR-1 | P2 | Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" — covered by this epic's string replacement scope. |
| HLR-2 | P2 | Documentation captions/references updated in affected topics — covered by this epic's documentation touch-up scope. |
